events.title: Woodland discovery walk
events.body:
The class will explore the woodland trail with their teachers.

## School bag
- Waterproof jacket and boots
- A filled water bottle
- A small snack

Return to school before lunch.

events.title: Family lantern workshop
events.body: Make a paper lantern together in the classroom. One adult may join each child. Materials are supplied.

events.body: School is closed for staff training. Plan care for this weekday.

documents.title: The school bag
documents.body:
## Every day
- A filled water bottle
- A small snack
- A change of clothes

## Outdoor days
Waterproof boots and a weatherproof jacket. Label belongings with your child’s name.

documents.title: Before and after school
documents.body:
## Morning care
From 07:30 in the family room.

## Afternoon care
From the end of the school day until 18:00.

Care requests are managed directly with the school. Saving a note here does not make a booking.

documents.title: Absence and collection
documents.body:
## Absence
Notify the school office before the start of the school day.

## Collection
Tell the class teacher if a different adult will collect your child.

This fictional policy demonstrates how a school document can become a concise web guide.
